[[File:Gg11blockcapsule.jpg|thumb]]
'''Block capsules''' were small vehicles made of metal alloy which resembled coffins. They were equipped with a small [[Engine/Legends|booster]]. They could only travel a few hundred meters before the booster would give out. They were typically used to move garbage, though creative individuals sometimes used them for quick getaways, being retrieved via a friendly ship's [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]].
